records.Title: Diary of a Human
records.ShortTxt:
Time: 1950s Dbp: 8.5
Genre: Drama
Awards: 12th Gunma Award for Best Cinematography
records.Txt:
In the mid-18th century, a devout young pastor believed that he could bring salvation to all beings solely with his own spiritual strength, even without the aid of ancient weapons.
However, he soon discovered the apathy among the common folk to the salvation of their souls or the concept of their consciousness returning to the mystical Sea of the Moon.
This realization led him to question his dedication and ultimately, he died alone, succumbing to long-term depression.

records.Title: Window
records.ShortTxt:
Time: 1950s Dbp: 8.7
Genre: Mystery/Thriller
Awards: 27th Osbar Nomination for Best Director, Osbar Nomination for Best Screenplay
records.Txt:
A professional comet photographer became immobilized due to a leg fracture from an accident.
Confined to his apartment, he began to observe his neighbors through his window out of sheer boredom.
Little did he know, the daily arguments from his neighbor harbored a murderous intent.
One day, his suspicions finally turned into a gruesome reality.

records.Title: Escape
records.ShortTxt:
Time: 1950s Dbp: 8.5
Genre: Drama/Thriller/War
Awards: 10th Golden Palm Nomination, Nomination for Best Screenplay
records.Txt:
During the third Lunar Overflow, numerous concentration camps were built to house countless individuals.
A prisoner named Francis, sentenced to death, crafted a flawless escape plan on the eve of his execution, setting off on a flight to freedom.
Legend says that those who watch this movie will find themselves trapped in an inescapable prison.

records.Title: The Sunlit Night
records.ShortTxt:
Time: 1950s Dbp: 8.2
Genre: Drama/Romance
Awards: 18th Gunma Award (Nomination)
records.Txt:
Clouds of steam covered the sky, plunging the city into eternal nights and sunless days.
Inside this prolonged darkness, a small ordinary romance unfolded.
One side is the promised reunion of a year-long apart, the other is the burning passion of love at first sight. Which one will prevail in the end?

records.Title: Psychiatric Patient
records.ShortTxt:
Time: 1960s Dbp: 8.9
Genre: Mystery/Thriller/Horror
Awards: 33rd Osbar Nomination for Best Director, Osbar Nomination for Best Supporting Actress
records.Txt:
After embezzling a large sum, a secretary escaped to a remote motel and met its mentally disturbed owner.
To her horror, she discovered that the owner was possessed by the spirit of his deceased mother. Afflicted by Chaos, she is now determined to kill anyone who tries to get close to her son.

records.Title: Birds
records.ShortTxt:
Time: 1960s Dbp: 8.1
Genre: Mystery/Thriller/Disaster
Awards: 36th Osbar Nomination for Best Director, Osbar Nomination for Best Supporting Actress
records.Txt:
Based on a true event in Carrola. The frequent meteor showers alter the local magnetic fields.
The local bird population suddenly turned aggressive and began to attack the local populace.
Faced with the savage and bloodthirsty flock, it’s either run or become feed for the carrion.

records.Title: The Donkey
records.ShortTxt:
Time: 1960s Dbp: 8.3
Genre: Drama
Awards: 27th Gunma Award (Nomination)
records.Txt:
Possibly the most unique film ever filmed.
A one of a kind cinema experience featuring a donkey as its protagonist. Through the donkey’s eyes, the audiences are led through a cold and cruel world. The donkey passed from one owner to another, before being eventually slaughtered.
Those who view this film have praised this film for making them feel truly like the donkey.

records.Title: The Lurker
records.ShortTxt:
Time: 1970s Dbp: 8.8
Genre: Drama/Sci-Fi/Mystery
Awards: Starlight Humanitarian Award
records.Txt:
A writer seeking inspiration and a scientist eager to uncover truths embark on an expedition led by a Carrola border guide through a region devastated a century earlier by a meteorite.
They are drawn to a mythical room rumored to fulfill the deepest desires and thoughts of whoever finds it.

records.Title: Merry Christmas, L
records.ShortTxt:
Time: 1980s Dbp: 8.8
Genre: Drama/Ethics/War
Awards: 36th Golden Palm Nomination
records.Txt:
War soon followed after the third Lunar Overflow.
In a Chaos POW camp, an unlikely relationship slowly began to develop between the human prisoner and the captor.
In the days that followed, this gut-wrenching conflict between loyalty and emotion began to go head to head.

records.Title: Mess
records.ShortTxt:
Time: 1980s Dbp: 8.9
Genre: Drama/Action/War
Awards: 58th Osbar Nomination for Best Director, Nomination for Best Cinematography
records.Txt:
three brothers, once united, turn against each other in a deadly quest for power.
As the flames of war flicker on the empire’s domain,
a mythical enemy from the distant past emerges.
Setting bitterness aside, the brothers are forced to unite against their most mortal enemy.
Wherever the ironclad steeds tread, victory shall follow!

records.Title: The Compassion
records.ShortTxt:
Time: 1980s Dbp: 8.8
Genre: Drama
Awards: 39th Golden Palm Nomination, Fecib Award
records.Txt:
An elderly man celebrates his birthday by planting a sapling with his grandchild.
That evening, an ominous broadcast reveals that a meteor is hurtling towards Carrola.
Consumed by despair, he prays for peace, willing to sacrifice everything to avert disaster.
Against all odds,
tranquility returns,
fulfilling an ancient prophecy that had foretold the future of Carrola.

records.Title: Angel’s Desire
records.ShortTxt:
Time: 1980s Dbp: 8.6
Genre: Drama/Romance/Fantasy
Awards: 40th Main Competition Golden Palm Nomination
records.Txt:
Two pairs of watchful eyes gaze over the city, the two Chaos—Kahir, who holds humans in contempt, and Danmier, who is moved by human emotions.
From their vantage point above, they listen to the wishes of the populace and silently observe the unfolding story of humanity.
All is well until, one day, one of the Chaos falls in love with a human.
In a twist of fate, his love compels him to join the ACD in an attempt to better aid humanity.

records.Title: Song of the Channelers
records.ShortTxt:
Time: 1980s Dbp: 9.1
Genre: Drama/Comedy/Crime/Fantasy
Awards: 42nd Main Competition Golden Palm Nomination
records.Txt:
In the newly established Ingboray Region, Nova, a young man’s love is thwarted by poverty and class prejudice.
Despite being one of the Channelers, he only possessed the ability to move objects with his mind.
Forced by fate’s cruel hands, he turns to a life of crime for the woman he loves.
Upon returning with wealth in hand, he finds his hometown transformed by modernity.
What was once his home is now a bustling metropolis with no trace of his past life remaining.

records.Title: Dream
records.ShortTxt:
Time: 1980s Dbp: 8.7
Genre: Drama/Fantasy
Awards: 14th Rainbow Island Best Picture, Best Director, Best Cinematography
records.Txt:
The love between human and Chaos, the blossoming petals on the snowy peaks, the ethereal walks of the dead, or a painter’s inner thoughts…
It’s said whoever watches this unfinished film will only see a mirror, reflecting only their innermost imagination before being imprinted onto the film reels.

records.Title: Uprising
records.ShortTxt:
Time: 1980s Dbp: 6.9
Genre: Comedy/Sci-Fi/Fantasy
Awards: 57th Osbar Nomination for Best Visual Effects
records.Txt:
In Karral’s Crown District, three professors studying chaos form the Anti-Chaos Squad.
Armed with a homemade shrinking device designed to capture Chaos, their mission takes an unexpected turn when an accident causes a Chaos to grow to monstrous proportions.
As the situation spirals out of control, they must find a way to reverse the Chaos they’ve unleashed.

records.Title: The Midsummer Night
records.ShortTxt:
Time: 1980s Dbp: 8.9
Genre: Drama/Crime/Youth
Awards: 28th Jinghong Award for Best Drama
records.Txt:
During Karral’s tumultuous civil war, the fierce struggle for power leads to heartbreak as two major families exploit the working class, resulting in many children losing their parents forever.
Despite the societal collapse around them, the children continue to live out their carefree summer days filled with playful antics and budding romances,
oblivious to the impending doom that will erase their youthful innocence.

records.Title: Fireworks
records.ShortTxt:
Time: 1990s Dbp: 8.7
Genre: Drama/Crime/Youth
Awards: 22nd Rainbow Island Best Picture
records.Txt:
At the turn of the millennium in Agiba City, an NCCA officer becomes entangled with the mafia in his struggle to support his ailing wife and disabled colleague. 
Driven to desperation, he robs a bank. After fulfilling his colleague’s final wishes, he uses the remainder of his funds to take his dying wife on a poignant journey, seeking redemption and closure in their final days together.

records.Title: The Birdfather
records.ShortTxt:
Time: 1990s Dbp: 8.9
Genre: Drama/Crime
Awards: 63rd Osbar Nomination for Best Picture, Nomination for Best Director.
records.Txt:
In the shadowy corners of Carrola’s Nocturnal District, the Plume Gang, under the leadership of the formidable godfather Corleone, rises to prominence.
Tragedy strikes when Corleone refuses a drug trade and is betrayed by the local drug lord. Faced with his son’s death, the godfather reveals his true form, spreading his wings and taking to the skies for a climactic final showdown.
